design: Three outer folds; three inner folds. StratifiedGroupKFold(shuffle=True). Group = batch plus filename-inferred participant identity, grouping lighting and repeated specimens. Provisional identity only; cross-batch identity unverified. All current data are development data. Selection uses inner macro F1, with inner accuracy as tie-breaker. Outer predictions never select candidates.
augmentation: Training only: two extra copies per row, saturation multiplied by .99/1.01 and value by .98/1.02, bounded to [0,1]. Hue unchanged. Heuristic, not demonstrated label-preserving physical lighting variation; not additional biological data.
metrics: Macro F1 includes all seven schema classes with zero for undefined F1, including unrepresented SG 1.000 and pH 8.0. This convention differs from the historical union-of-observed/predicted-label report. Sensitivity/specificity averages exclude undefined denominators and class support is exposed. No quality/confidence/distance filtering. Exact semiquantitative categories, not disease detection.
